title: ASHTAS Operative
description: Introductory road safety and traffic management operative training program.

title: NZGTTM Essentials
description: Foundational training in the New Zealand Guidelines for Temporary Traffic Management.

title: NZGTTM Risk Assessment & TMP Fundamentals
description: Six-module course on the NZGTTM risk-based approach: identifying, analysing and rating TTM risks, selecting controls for lowest total risk, building the risk register and TMP, and keeping the plan live on site.

title: Core Engineering Concepts of TTM in New Zealand
description: Narrated deck covering the core engineering principles behind temporary traffic management design.

title: Working with Portable Traffic Signals
description: SELA certified training for the safe setup and operation of portable traffic signals on site.

title: Roles & Responsibilities for TTM in New Zealand
description: Who does what on a TTM site -- roles, responsibilities, and accountability under NZ practice.

title: Stop Wasting Your Money
description: The average household loses $2,628 a year to forgotten subscriptions. A practical, quick-read guide to finding and cutting the leaks.

title: Working Safely Near Barrier Systems
description: Site Safety Awareness module for crew, subcontractors, and site visitors working on or near temporary or permanent barrier systems.

title: Staging & Vehicles on Side Roads
description: Toolbox-style module on safe staging and vehicle placement when working on side roads.

title: Assist with Temporary Traffic Management within the Road Reserve
description: Built against Skill Standard 40233 (NZQA Level 3, 5 credits): online learning plus a practical sign-off on site for assisting with temporary traffic management within the road reserve.

title: Protecting Vulnerable Road Users in TTM
description: Keep people walking, cycling, using mobility devices or catching the bus safe around TTM sites: footpaths, cycle routes, crossings, bus stops, level crossings and on-site checks.

title: Force & the Body: Why Road Workers Are Vulnerable
description: Why road workers are so vulnerable to traffic: Newton's laws and the body, speed, energy and human limits, and applying the physics on site.

title: TTM Site Assurance Assessor
description: Six-module online course for experienced TTM practitioners moving into independent site assurance: the NZGTTM assurance processes, who gets hurt at worksites, G1–G8 and Sela priority checks, site outcomes and Stop Work Orders, and writing findings that stand up. Includes 12 months' access to the Sela assessment tools. Supervised field assessments for Sela endorsement are available on request.
